and  resolved resonance analysis of Er
ANNRI(BL04) beamline of MLF at J-PARC.
Spallation reaction in a mercury target
The proton beams were supplied at a repetition rate
of 25 Hz and in the "double-bunch mode", in which
two consecutive 100 ns-wide proton bunches were shot
to produce neutrons with a time difference of 600 ns.
Produced neutrons were slowed down in a supercritical
Energy resolution of the pulsed neutron was given.

paramagnetic cross-section of nat-Er were given.
